criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve allowed record identifiers and missing-safe sentinels
map exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed record identifiers and maps only exact need/capability matches to direct coverage. The two needs without matching capabilities remain unsupported with empty capability_id, which matches the declared role and observed final coverage.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. That causes covered needs to be ranked before actually unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs. The final priorities show direct-coverage rows marked unsupported:true and unsupported-coverage rows marked unsupported:false.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and derives the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The bad top priority is inherited from the failed prioritization boundary rather than introduced here.
